earlier_scan.source_named: Kouadio N'Guessan, Jeremie 1983. L'abe. In Herault (ed.), Atlas des langues kwa de Cote d'Ivoire, pp. 13-39. Abidjan: ACCT/ILA.
earlier_scan.note: Kwa lagoon language, almost certainly tonal, but no stress/tone statement was readable online; atlas chapter not accessible.

sources.citation: Grambank, language page abee1242 (contributor Roberto E. Herrera Miranda), accessed 2026-09-17.
sources.note: 195 morphosyntactic datapoints, all sourced to 'Gbery 1987' with page numbers; Grambank has no stress feature.

Give consonant and vowel inventories (9 oral vowels, ATR harmony) from N'Guessan 1983 but say nothing about tone or stress; fr.wikipedia adds the references Dumestre 1971 (pp. 48-56) and Yapi 2013 (Recueil de contes abbey, mémoire, Université FHB).

sources.citation: Delafosse, Maurice. 1904. Vocabulaires comparatifs de plus de 60 langues ou dialectes parlés à la Côte d'Ivoire et dans les régions limitrophes. Paris: Leroux.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Contains an 'abè' wordlist (collected 1900 at Dabou from an Agni of Tiassalé, i.e. a non-native informant, p. 15-16) and group notes on Alaguian/Avikam/Ari/Abè/Adyoukrou (initial vowels, negation), but nothing on Abè accent or tone. The only remark on accent is general, p. 3: 'Quant à l'accent tonique ou plutôt l'intonation, dont l'importance est souvent considérable dans les langues nègres.. il est impossible de donner ces indications au moyen de signes alphabétiques.' Not a statement about Abé.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3, languoid abee1242 (Hammarström et al.); full reference table via langdoc?language=abee1242.
sources.note: Lists exactly four references for Abé: Gbery 1987 (grammar), N'Guessan 1983 (grammar sketch), Dumestre 1971 (overview/wordlist), Delafosse 1904 (wordlist). No phonology-typed work exists for the language.

sources.citation: N'Guessan, Jérémie Kouadio. 1983. L'abbey. In Georges Hérault (ed.), Atlas des langues kwa de Côte d'Ivoire, tome 1: Monographies, 13-39. Abidjan: ILA / ACCT.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: open copy online (also online with a university library login)
sources.note: The standard French sketch; the sister chapters in the same tome (Abouré, Abidji) each contain a 'phonologie' section with a tone system, so this chapter very likely states the tonal/accentual system of Abé. Print only (ILA Abidjan; copies in French and US Africana collections).

sources.citation: Yapi, Ameh Pascal. 2013. Recueil de contes abbey. Mémoire, Université Félix Houphouët-Boigny, Abidjan.

sources.note: Recent Abidjan MA thesis with Abbey texts; such mémoires usually open with a phonological sketch including the tone system. Existence known only from fr.wikipedia; not online.

sources.citation: Koopman, Hilda & Dominique Sportiche. 1989. Pronouns, logical variables, and logophoricity in Abe. Linguistic Inquiry 20(4): 555-588.

sources.citation: Gbery, Eddy Aimé. 1987. Studies in the grammar of Abbey. PhD dissertation, University of Rochester. Ann Arbor: UMI (ProQuest 8803313), xvi+217 pp.

sources.access_detail: online with a university library login
sources.note: The only full-length grammar of Abé; a 217-page dissertation almost certainly has a phonology chapter with a tone (and possibly stress) statement; Grambank and Glottolog treat it as the reference description. Available through ProQuest Dissertations (the Harvard library catalogue) and physically at the MPI-EVA library, shelf PL 8036.A5 GBE 2005.
